title: Retrospective analysis of the cohort of patients with anxiety, obsessive-compulsive and obsessive-compulsive related disorders at the departement of psychiatry and psychotherapy
summary: This is a retrospective analysis of patients with anxiety, obsessive-compulsive and obsessive-compulsive related disorders from the Department of Psychiatry and Psychotherapy at the University Medical Center Freiburg. Clinical data and especially diagnostic findings as well as the response to therapy during routine treatment will be analyzed. In particular, it will be analyzed how many of the patients had an organic, i.e. physically caused anxiety, obsessive-compulsive and obsessive-compulsive spectrum disorder.
conditions: Anxiety, obsessive-compulsive and compulsive spectrum disorders

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of three patient cohorts with related disorders

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Data from patients with all anxiety, obsessive-compulsive and obsessive-compulsive spectrum disorders treated at the Department of Psychiatry and Psychotherapy, University Medical Center Freiburg, both as outpatients and, above all, as (partial) inpatients, should be analyzed. Patients with anxiety, obsessive-compulsive and compulsive spectrum disorders with organic causes or as a result of substance use should also be explicitly analyzed. Comorbidities are also not an exclusion criterion. Only patients aged ≥ 18 years should be analyzed. Patients from 2000 at the earliest until July 2025 should be included. For the subproject regarding tissue-based assay findings, all patients > 18 years of age who have received a corresponding analysis from CSF/serum pairs since 2018 should be included transdiagnostically.
Exclusion criteria:
<18 years
